description: Fetch a single USPTO patent application/grant by application number (`number`, e.g. "16/123,456" or "16123456") or by an already-granted patent number (`patent_number`, e.g. "11646472") — pass whichever one you actually have. Returns full metadata: title, inventors, classifications, status, and — when the application has been granted — `patent_number`, `grant_date`, `publication_number`, `publication_date`. **8-digit application numbers and 8-digit patent numbers can be the SAME digit string for a different record** (application series codes 10-12 were used ~2003-2008, and granted patent numbers entered that same 10,000,000-12,999,999 range in 2018 and are still in it) — e.g. "11646472" is BOTH application 11/646,472 (a 2006 filing) AND patent 11,646,472 (a 2023 grant), two unrelated inventions. If you only pass `number` and it is an 8-digit value in that collision range, this tool checks BOTH interpretations; if both exist, it returns `ambiguous: true` with each record summarized rather than silently guessing — re-call with `number` for the application or `patent_number` for the patent. Passing `patent_number` explicitly always skips the ambiguity check. A `status` of "Patented Case" with `patent_number: null` means USPTO ODP omitted that field for this record (check `patent_number_warning`), not that the patent was never granted; a pending application correctly has `patent_number: null`, `grant_date: null`.

_apiKey.description: USPTO ODP API key. Get free at https://data.uspto.gov/myodp.

number.description: An application number, digits only or with slashes (e.g. "16123456", "16/123,456"). If this happens to also be a valid 8-digit granted patent number (see the collision note above), the response may come back `ambiguous: true` — pass `patent_number` instead to mean the patent unambiguously.

patent_number.description: An already-granted US patent number, digits only (e.g. "11646472", "10000000"). Use this instead of `number` whenever you specifically mean the patent, not the application — it is never ambiguous.

name: get_patent
title: Get Patent
